viator_experiences.description_md: This full-day trip from London heads into the Kent countryside to visit two of England's top wineries and a working cheese dairy. Train transit is included, so there is no need to organise your own transport. At each estate, guests enjoy insider tours with guided tastings, a picnic lunch, and a tutored tasting of six English wines paired with six English cheeses. The day is ideal for visiting food and drink lovers, with everything arranged in advance and free cancellation available up to 24 hours before departure.

viator_experiences.description_md: England's wine scene is more exciting than ever, and this full-day tour from London takes the hassle out of visiting two of the country's top wineries. Departing in the morning from Greenwich, you travel in the comfort of a private vehicle to Kent, home to the renowned Chapel Down and Gusbourne estates. At each winery you enjoy a guided tour and a tutored tasting of both still and sparkling wines, followed by a delicious lunch of local cuisine. The day is limited to a maximum of sixteen travellers and returns to the Greenwich meeting point in the evening.
